view.camera: persp.Camera(262, 590): eye 359 cm over the deck, Z0 875, focal 800, vanishing x 400
view.ship: keel across the picture, bow left (-x), stern right (+x); x 0 at the picture's middle; near side z -60 (cut away), far bulwark z 540, centreline z 240; the deck level

light: noon, the sun high in the south (about 66 degrees), behind us and a little to the left (we face NNW across the ship, heading WSW): faces toward us, the left and up are lit; shadows short, away and a little right, flat and blue
walk_note: one area: the near walkway from the bow to the stern (the near side is cut away, as a stage's fourth wall), the mast's gangway, the bow's deck forward of the hold, the stern's deck aft of it; the cargo, the far walkway and the deckhouse are outside it; the step, the hearth, the bale, the windlass, the compass's post, the tiller and the front things are blocked

planes.what: the far sea and the cape of Daiozaki on the horizon: it rocks a pixel or two on the long swell (fx swell)
the great sail on its yard, filling (fx sail-breath)
the sheets, the brace and a lift: ropes from the sail and the yard down to the deck
the mast, iron-ringed, from its step out of the picture's top; whoever stands behind its step passes behind it
the windlass at the stern: its drum, cheek posts and two bars
the long tiller and the rudder's head: whoever is beyond the tiller passes behind it

the nearest things on the walkway at the picture's bottom corners: a coil of rope and a bucket (left), a water cask (right edge)

the rice pot in the hearth box (its lid)

seijiro.what: Seijiro sits on the bale (its top 42 cm up), his feet at the mark

kota.what: Kota squats (or sits on his heels) at the hearth box's left, facing it

fx.what: the sea's rows running past the ship toward the stern (she goes left, the water goes right), fast
fx.note: the waves kind in one direction, faster than a bay's; drawn OVER the swell layer (so the far rows show on it) and under everything else; the area is the sea as seen in the backdrop (it stops at the cargo, the boat, the bulwark, the stem and the deckhouse)

fx.what: the long slow swell: the far sea and the cape rise and fall and the horizon tilts a pixel or two
fx.note: the swell layer covers rows 238-298 (the cape above the horizon, the far sea below it); the backdrop's sky runs 3 rows below the horizon under it, so the horizon can drop; its lower edge lies in a flat band of the sea, so a pixel or two of travel shows no seam

fx.what: the sail breathing in the wind: its foot and leech stir a pixel or two
fx.note: a sway from the top edge (the yard is out of the picture at the left); ENGINE-21 may give it a breathing kind of its own (the foot's middle bellying out and back): the sky is painted complete under it

fx.what: spray flung up over the bow now and then, blown aft (to the right) and away
fx.note: a new small kind (ENGINE-21): a burst of white drops rising from `at` and falling back, `lean` the wind's push; until then a short smoke puff in white will stand for it

fx.what: the floating cask (nagashi-daru) bobbing past on the sea now and then, toward the stern
fx.note: a flyer that floats: its frames (40 x 26, the waterline's middle at (20, 19)) bob in turn; it stays on its lane (no rise and fall but the frames'), hidden where the cargo and the bulwark stand (clip)

fx.what: gulls over the ship (the engine's own silhouettes, white as Yui's)
fx.note: white against the cobalt and cerulean of the sky; they fly beyond the sail and the mast (hidden behind the sail: `behind`)

fx.what: the charcoal under the rice pot, in the hearth box's mouth
a thread of smoke from the hearth box, blown away and aft
steam from the rice pot while it boils (with the pot's steam state)

fx_note: ENGINE-21 drives: the sea's rows (waves, toward the stern, fast), the swell (the swell layer on a slow bob with a tilt), the sail breathing (the sail layer), spray at the bow now and then (a new small kind), the floating cask (a flyer that floats: three frames), gulls (flyers); the hearth's embers and smoke, and the pot's steam when it boils. Nothing that moves is painted still.

closeup.what: the compass box's lid propped (state open) as the close-up opens; shut again when it closes
